mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vip_api_registry (api_path, http_method, controller_class, method_name, platform_code, benefit_code, consume, message, scan_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{apiPath}, #{httpMethod}, #{controllerClass}, #{methodName}, #{platformCode}, #{benefitCode}, #{consume}, #{message}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW()) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE controller_class = new.controller_class, method_name = new.method_name, platform_code = new.platform_code, benefit_code = new.benefit_code, consume = new.consume, message = new.message, scan_time = NOW()
